TextLines: <color=#d0d0d0>Raidlands is built for fast progression, direct conflict, and clear tools.</color>
<color=#b0b0b0>Use this panel for the server overview and the full command index.</color>
<color=#ffd166>/commands</color> - Jump straight to the command index
<color=#ffffff>Build fast. Raid smart. Hold your ground.</color>
<color=#d0d0d0>Raidlands runs a combat-focused ruleset with quality-of-life systems.</color>
<color=#ffd166>/home NAME</color> - Teleport to a saved home
<color=#ffd166>/tpr PLAYER</color> - Request teleport to a player
<color=#ffd166>/home NAME</color> - Teleport to a saved home
<color=#ffd166>/sethome NAME</color> - Save your current home point
<color=#d0d0d0>Teleport timers and limits come from the active server rules.</color>
<color=#d0d0d0>Admin teleport controls live on the Staff tab.</color>
<color=#ffd166>/autoauth</color> - Share auth with team, friends, or clan
<color=#d0d0d0>Use the Utility tab for sorting, backpack, time, and smelt toggles.</color>
<color=#ffd166>/s</color> or <color=#ffd166>/shop</color> - Open the Raidlands rewards store
<color=#ffd166>/pm PLAYER MESSAGE</color> - Send a private message
<color=#d0d0d0>Staff drop, loot, and anti-cheat commands are on the Staff tab.</color>

Commands.Description: Toggle accepting team, clan, or friend teleport requests
Share authorization with team, friends, or clan
ServerArmour checks, reports, and map upload
